name: short-url-cfworker
description: A self-hosted URL shortener on Cloudflare Workers + D1, with an admin page.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin page at `/admin`. Use a long, random string. / 後台 `/admin` 的登入密碼，請用夠長的隨機字串。

HOME_URL.description: Optional. Where to send visitors who open the bare domain. Leave empty to show a simple page. / 選填。直接開啟網域首頁時要轉去的網址，留空則顯示簡單頁面。

DB.description: D1 database that stores your links. A new one is created for you. / 存放短網址的 D1 資料庫，會自動幫你建立。
